channel.title: ScaledLearning Guides
channel.description: Practical guides on scaled learning, AI-driven OKRs, AI governance, Kaizen events and knowledge management.

item.title: What is scaled learning?
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: Scaled learning means building an organization that learns faster as it grows: peer learning, captured knowledge and AI agents. A practitioner's guide.

item.title: The learning organization guide: habits, obstacles and AI
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: What a learning organization is, the habits that define one, common obstacles, and how AI agents can help teams learn together faster. A practitioner's guide.

item.title: AI-driven OKRs: a practical guide for teams
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: A practical guide to AI-driven OKRs: where AI helps write, check and track objectives and key results, where people must decide, and a quarterly rhythm.

item.title: AI-driven balanced scorecards: strategy, measures and learning
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: How to bring AI and data into the balanced scorecard: four perspectives, strategy maps that update, trustworthy metrics and a review rhythm that drives learning.

item.title: AI governance and data governance: a practical playbook
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: A practical guide to AI governance and data governance: risk tiers, ownership, human oversight, monitoring and incident response that enable AI.

item.title: Kaizen events for AI-enabled work: how to run one
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: How to run a Kaizen event for work that includes AI agents: scoping, team, agenda, redesigning handoffs, testing changes during the event and sustaining gains.

item.title: AI-driven PI planning: a guide to multi-team planning
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: A practical guide to AI-driven PI planning: how AI agents help prepare, run and follow up multi-team, big-room planning without replacing the human conversation.

item.title: Value stream identification: a workshop guide
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: How to run a value stream identification workshop: name your value streams, map steps and people, and find where AI agents fit in the flow of value.

item.title: Knowledge management in the age of AI agents
item.dc:creator: Jonathan Davis
item.description: How to build knowledge management that AI agents can use: capture tacit know-how, structure context, assign owners and review dates, and keep agents grounded.
